observatories.name: Wildlife Trafficking Global Observatory (Observatório Global de Tráfico de Animais)
observatories.global_south: Source-side view from Brazil and the Amazon basin.
observatories.features: OSINT event map, filters by country / fauna group / year / transport mode, CSV export, seizure submission by e-mail

status.note: The page calls itself a 'demonstration base' awaiting OSINT data; the 'fully active' claim in the spreadsheet is overstated.

vannetra.how: The direct inspiration: event map + filters + news-source view. Pugmark keeps the structure, moves to a light glass UI, and adds case merging, a link-analysis workbench and a privacy gate.

observatories.name: TRAFFIC Wildlife Trade Portal
observatories.global_south: Tracks flows from African and Asian source hubs to demand markets.
observatories.features: Open-source seizure records, taxonomic search (scientific names act as a cross-language key), route and transport-mode charts

status.note: Spreadsheet linked a 2020 TRAFFIC Bulletin PDF, not the portal; corrected.

vannetra.how: Benchmark for India / SE Asia coverage; its taxonomic keys match the lexicon's `taxa`. Automated use needs TRAFFIC's permission, so none is attempted.

observatories.name: C4ADS Wildlife Seizure Dashboard
observatories.global_south: Maps the logistics (airports, seaports, routes) that link African and Asian source areas to demand markets.
observatories.features: 10+ years of seizures across 100+ jurisdictions, filters by transport sector (air, sea, land, mail)

vannetra.how: Pugmark's `modes` field (air/sea/rail/road/post/online) follows its transport-sector framing, so the two are comparable.

observatories.name: ROUTES Air Transport Dashboard
observatories.global_south: Airport-level view of routes that leave source countries.
observatories.features: Air-seizure database, airport and route analytics

status.note: Found while verifying the C4ADS entry.

vannetra.how: Airport names feed the gazetteer's `airport` type; air cases can be cross-checked against it.

observatories.name: Elephant Trade Information System (ETIS)
observatories.global_south: Tracks ivory from savannah and forest elephant range states.
observatories.features: Ivory seizure records, trend analysis for CITES meetings
observatories.access: aggregated public reports only; records restricted

status.note: cites.org returns 403 to automated checks; the page exists in a browser.

vannetra.how: Trend reports give the baseline to compare Pugmark's ivory cases against.

observatories.name: EIA Global Environmental Crime Tracker
observatories.focus: Global; strong on timber, marine, big cats
observatories.global_south: Strong on totoaba ("aquatic cocaine") and rosewood.
observatories.features: Interactive map of seizures, arrests and convictions, normalised into English

vannetra.how: Convictions help calibrate the `conviction` event type; big-cat cases seed workbench charts.

observatories.name: UNODC World WISE
observatories.global_south: The basis of the World Wildlife Crime Report.
observatories.features: Official seizure records from CITES annual illegal-trade reports

vannetra.how: Aggregates put Pugmark's media-derived counts in context (media bias).

observatories.name: ECO-SOLVE Global Monitoring System
observatories.entity: Global Initiative Against Transnational Organized Crime (GI-TOC)
observatories.global_south: Its hubs sit in the countries with the biggest regional online markets. Its bulletins include South Asia (musk deer) and Cameroon.
observatories.features: Manual monitoring + local-language hubs + AI discovery; 13,254 ads detected Apr 2024 – Aug 2025 (84% on Facebook)

vannetra.how: The same hybrid design as Pugmark's listing classifier: a machine ranks, a person decides (review queue). Their musk-deer bulletin is a direct benchmark for the WCS-OWT musk-deer group.

observatories.name: WILDTRADE (ERC) · Helsinki Lab of Interdisciplinary Conservation Science
observatories.entity: University of Helsinki (PI Enrico Di Minin)
observatories.focus: Global online trade; social media + machine learning
observatories.global_south: Found 1,600+ primates for sale in six weeks, and species never before recorded as traded.
observatories.features: Automated social-media collection, deep-learning filters (text + image), species identification

status.note: wildtrade.fi did not resolve; CORDIS results page used.

vannetra.how: Methodological anchor for the relevance classifier (group-aware evaluation, human-in-the-loop). Next step it points to: image classifiers for listings.

observatories.name: Coalition to End Wildlife Trafficking Online
observatories.global_south: Aims to stop online sales of species poached in the Global South.
observatories.features: Prohibited-wildlife policy framework, staff training, detection filters; keyword list (1,170+ terms) shared with member companies only

vannetra.how: Why Pugmark's codeword list is a flag-only watchlist: publishing a full evasion list helps sellers adapt.

observatories.name: SHERLOC · case law and legislation
observatories.global_south: Prosecution outcomes in source countries show where legal gaps are.
observatories.features: Case-law database, national legislation, treaties

status.note: Spreadsheet pointed SHERLOC to illegalwildlifetradeprojects.org (the World Bank GWP site); corrected.

vannetra.how: Legal outcomes for cases Pugmark tracks; convictions confirm the `conviction` event type.

observatories.name: Wildlife Data Collaborative
observatories.entity: Farmingdale State College + John Jay College (CUNY) partners
observatories.global_south: Price data links source-country harvest to demand-market value.
observatories.features: Wildlife Prosecutions Database (US federal cases, open); Price of Wildlife Database (on request)

vannetra.how: Price references would let Pugmark sanity-check reported ₹ values; not ingested.

observatories.name: Indian Kanoon (court judgments)
observatories.global_south: India's case law under the Wildlife (Protection) Act 1972.
observatories.features: Full-text judgments, API (paid token)

vannetra.how: Planned collector for convictions. Judgments name the accused, so they stay in data/private and only counts are published.

observatories.name: CITES Trade Database
observatories.global_south: Records exporters in range states and importers in demand markets.
observatories.features: Shipment-level legal trade; source code I = confiscated/seized specimens

vannetra.how: `vannetra cites` aggregates exporter→importer flows per species group: the legal demand/supply baseline on the Trade page.

observatories.name: TimberStats
observatories.global_south: Flora is most of the illegal trade by value and is under-watched.
observatories.features: Mirror-trade analysis that flags importer/exporter mismatches by HS code, year and country

status.note: timberstats.org did not resolve; TRAFFIC's launch page used.

vannetra.how: Mirror-trade gaps are the model for a future red-sanders module (India → China/HK), using Comtrade HS 4403/4407.

observatories.name: LEMIS (US Fish & Wildlife Service imports)
observatories.entity: USFWS; open release by Eskew et al. 2020
observatories.global_south: Demand-side record of legal imports from Asian exporters.
observatories.features: 2000–2014 shipment records

vannetra.how: Optional demand-side layer next to CITES.

observatories.name: Dataset of seized wildlife and their intended uses (PMC8579131)
observatories.entity: Stringham et al., University of Adelaide · Data in Brief 2021
observatories.focus: Global; TRAFFIC portal + CITES + LEMIS seizures 2010–2019
observatories.global_south: The closest open "codebook". It maps local and indigenous names to species and their commercial use.
observatories.features: ~4,900 taxa, 45,000+ common names (8,832 English + 37,507 in 125 other languages), 11,000 taxa-use combinations, 304 use search words

status.note: figshare blocks scripted downloads; fetch the zip in a browser.

vannetra.how: `vannetra codebook <zip>` merges its multilingual names into the lexicon (pmc_<lang> keys) and adds each group's intended uses.

observatories.name: Species+ / CITES Checklist API
observatories.global_south: Legal status per population, e.g. Himalayan musk deer (App. I).
observatories.features: CITES and CMS listings, API

vannetra.how: Will replace the lexicon's group-level CITES labels with taxon-level listings.

observatories.name: GBIF
observatories.global_south: Species ranges show where a seized animal could have come from.
observatories.features: Occurrence API, vernacular names

vannetra.how: Planned: range overlay on the case map.

observatories.name: GeoNames
observatories.global_south: District-level geocoding for rural seizures.
observatories.features: 21,700 in-scope places incl. every Indian district seat

vannetra.how: `vannetra gazetteer` builds the offline place index.

observatories.name: GDELT DOC 2.0
observatories.global_south: Picks up regional and vernacular outlets that global databases miss.
observatories.features: Article search API, ~3-month window

status.note: Throttles bursts with a penalty window; Pugmark paces requests and stops after two throttled replies.

vannetra.how: Primary open news collector.

observatories.name: SMART (Spatial Monitoring and Reporting Tool)
observatories.entity: SMART Partnership (WCS, WWF, ZSL, FZS and others)
observatories.global_south: The ranger-patrol standard in source countries.
observatories.features: Open-source patrol data model, reporting frameworks

vannetra.how: Model for data governance: code and frameworks are open, operational data stays with its owners. Pugmark splits public and local data the same way.

observatories.name: TradeMapper
observatories.entity: TRAFFIC with WWF-UK and Arcadia (built by Aptivate)
observatories.global_south: Lets small NGOs map their own spreadsheets without writing code.
observatories.features: CSV → interactive route map; up to 3 TopoJSON layers; open source (trademapper/trademapper-js)

vannetra.how: Same bring-your-own-data idea as the Workbench's local CSV import: your data stays in your browser.

observatories.name: Global Wildlife Program · IWT Projects Database
observatories.entity: World Bank / GEF Global Wildlife Program
observatories.global_south: Shows where counter-trafficking funding lands in source countries.
observatories.features: Map of donor-funded counter-IWT projects

vannetra.how: Overlay idea: are cases clustering where no project operates?

observatories.name: #WildEye (Oxpeckers)
observatories.focus: Europe; separate Asia, Eastern Africa and global maps
observatories.global_south: Follows cases through to court outcomes, not only seizures.
observatories.features: Geojournalism map of seizures, arrests, court cases and convictions; open-source tool

status.note: Main map is Europe, not 'all of Europe and Asia' as claimed; regional maps exist.

vannetra.how: Case lifecycle (seizure → arrest → court → conviction) is Pugmark's `kind` progression.

observatories.name: Oxpeckers "Vietnam Traffickers" files
observatories.global_south: Documents the source-to-demand route.
observatories.features: Syndicate mapping from court documents

vannetra.how: Example network to rebuild by hand in the Workbench (local data only).

observatories.name: Operation Jaguar reports
observatories.global_south: Jaguar parts relabelled as "tiger" for Asian buyers.
observatories.features: Undercover investigation, crime-convergence analysis

vannetra.how: Candidate source for verifying 'tigre americano' (currently watchlist only).

observatories.name: Wildlife Justice Commission reports
observatories.global_south: Investigations of transnational networks.
observatories.features: Network investigations, convergence reports

vannetra.how: Network diagrams to rebuild in the Workbench.

observatories.name: WildScan
observatories.global_south: Species ID at the point of sale, in local languages.
observatories.features: Offline species-ID library, incident reporting to authorities

vannetra.how: Linked from case reports as the place to report live-animal trade in SE Asia.

observatories.name: Wildlife Witness
observatories.global_south: Tourist and local reports from markets.
observatories.features: Photo + geotag reports routed to TRAFFIC analysts

status.note: Taronga says the app is offline due to technical issues. The spreadsheet URL is a 404; corrected.

vannetra.how: Reference only while offline.

observatories.name: ENV Wildlife Crime Hotline & reports
observatories.focus: Vietnam, a major demand and transit hub
observatories.global_south: The link between source flows and retail sale.
observatories.features: Hotline, crime database, reports

status.note: Returns 403 to automated checks; opens in a browser.

vannetra.how: Reporting channel for Vietnam; reports seed cases.

observatories.name: Wildlife Sentinel
observatories.features: Anonymous reporting app for airline staff and travellers (as claimed)

status.note: Named only in the Gemini text; no official page found. Kept so the gap is visible.

vannetra.how: Not used until verified.

observatories.name: Wildlife Crime Control Bureau (India)
observatories.global_south: India's national enforcement agency; issues species and operation alerts.
observatories.features: Operation reports, alerts, enforcement statistics

status.note: Did not respond to automated requests.

vannetra.how: Official reporting channel for India, linked from case reports.
